title: Eleven Words in a Dark Room
subtitle: 电影影像 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 电影影像（文学艺术与体育·电影与影像）
meta: 主题语境：电影影像（文学艺术与体育·电影与影像）　|　核心词汇：woman　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 woman 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① woman in the film said eleven words and the whole cinema went quiet, and my grandmother, who had not wanted to go, said afterwards that it was the only true thing she had seen in thirty-one years, and no woman, she said, is ever in a film twice. The ② woman who cleaned the cinema, and who had seen it eleven times, said the same thing happened every time and always at the same line.

The paper called her a ③ woman of no education and enormous courage, which my grandmother said was half a compliment and half an insult, and that the insult was the half anybody remembered, because a woman who says nothing is easier to write about.

My mother said the ④ woman in her came out when she was angry, which is a thing people said in 1974 and nobody says now, and which my mother meant entirely as praise. As a ⑤ woman, meaning as a member of a sex and not as a person, she was asked about it eleven times and answered it once, in 1979, by saying she had never been asked about anything else.

In 1975 she went to a meeting about ⑥ women's pay, and the woman next to her said nothing at all, and she came home early and said she had been spoken to as if she were a child. In 1981 she said it to me ⑦ woman to woman, which she had never done before, and I was thirty-one and I understood about half of it.

My grandfather called her my ⑧ woman, as everybody in the village did then, and she hated it and never once asked him to stop. The ⑨ woman I remember from the photograph is thirty-one and standing in a doorway, and I have never seen the film and I do not intend to. The ⑩ woman in the cinema that night, meaning my grandmother, said nothing on the way home and cried at the kitchen table, and my father said he had never seen it before and never saw it again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 女人；成年女子
B. n. 女性（作为性别的一员，与 man 相对）
C. n. 女人；妻子／伴侣（口语 my woman）
D. n. 女工；女佣（cleaning woman 等）
E. n. 女性气质；女人的一面（the woman in ...）
F. 固定搭配：a woman of ... 具有……的女性
G. 固定搭配：women's ... 女性的……（women's pay）
H. 固定搭配：woman to woman 女人对女人地；坦率地

items.q: The woman in the film said eleven words
The woman who cleaned the cinema
The paper called her a woman of no education
the woman in her came out when she was angry
As a woman, meaning as a member
she said it to me woman to woman
My grandfather called her my woman
The woman I remember from the photograph
The woman in the cinema that night

answers.why: the woman 意为“那个女人、女子”，电影里那个女人只说了十一个字，全场都安静了。
the woman who cleaned ... 意为“做清洁的女工”，打扫影院的那位女工看过十一遍，说每次都一样。
a woman of ... 意为“具有……的女性”，报纸称她为没受过教育而勇气非凡的女性。
the woman in her 意为“她身上女性的那一面、女人味”，母亲说她生气时女性的一面就出来了。
as a woman 意为“作为女性（这一性别的一员）”，她以女性的身份被问过十一次。
women's pay 意为“女性的工资、妇女报酬”，1975 年她去参加了一个关于女性工资的集会。
woman to woman 意为“女人对女人地、坦率地”，1981 年她以女人对女人的方式对我说了这件事。
my woman 意为“我的女人、我老婆”，祖父叫她“我的女人”，当时村里人都这么叫。
the woman 意为“（照片里的）女人”，我记得的照片里那个女人三十一岁，站在一道门口。
the woman 意为“那个女人”，那天晚上在影院里的那个女人，也就是我祖母，回家路上什么也没说。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 电影里那个女人只说了十一个字，全场都安静了。（woman）
打扫影院的那位女工看过十一遍，说每次都一样，而且总在同一句。（woman）
报纸称她为没受过教育而勇气非凡的女性。（a woman of）
母亲说她生气时女性的一面就出来了，这在 1974 年是人们的说法。（the woman in ...）
1975 年她去参加了一个关于女性工资的集会，提前回了家。（women's）
1981 年她以女人对女人的方式对我说了这件事，那是第一次。（woman to woman）
answers: The woman in the film said eleven words and the whole cinema went quiet.
The woman who cleaned the cinema had seen it eleven times and said it happened at the same line every time.
The paper called her a woman of no education and enormous courage.
My mother said the woman in her came out when she was angry, which is what people said in 1974.
In 1975 she went to a meeting about women's pay and came home early.
In 1981 she said it to me woman to woman, which she had never done before.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 woman 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: The woman in the film said eleven words and the whole cinema went quiet, and the woman who cleaned the cinema had seen it eleven times.
The paper called her a woman of no education and enormous courage, half a compliment and half an insult.
My mother said the woman in her came out when she was angry, and as a woman she was asked about it eleven times.
In 1975 she went to a meeting about women's pay and came home early.
In 1981 she said it to me woman to woman, and my grandfather called her my woman, as everybody did then.
The woman I remember from the photograph is thirty-one and standing in a doorway, and the woman in the cinema that night said nothing on the way home.
